title: So much fun and Definitely Instructional
text:
My brief to Mila was to challenge my rigid style of dressing and take me to a look which is edgy, interesting, and eclectic but still in line with my classic style.

Mila was so great… she accepted the challenge and we went for it.  

We had so much fun. I had a strict budget and we successfully bought a number of pieces which I know I will wear over and over again.   

We also spent quite a lot of time discussing why some fashion works and why some doesn’t and in particular what works for me.

I found it incredibly instructional and I learnt so much. It’s given me confidence to really lift my
